title: WNBA Team Tempo Awaits Brittney Sykes's Return to End Losing Streak
summary: The WNBA team Tempo is anticipating the return of guard Brittney Sykes from a foot injury. Her return is seen as a potential boost to help the team end a 10-game losing streak. Sykes is expected to be available for Tuesday's game.
summary_points: WNBA team Tempo expects Brittney Sykes to return from a foot injury.
Sykes's return is intended to help the team end a 10-game losing streak.
The guard is anticipated to be available for Tuesday's game.
